/* the same count as the page: his real-hours figure if set, otherwise every logged block (newspaper included) except "not study" */
function studyHours(lg){if(!lg)return 0;if(lg.realH!=null)return +lg.realH;const b=Object.values(lg.blocks||{});if(b.length)return b.reduce((s,x)=>x.nostudy?s:s+(+x.hours||0),0);return lg.hours!=null?+lg.hours:0}
